utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive! I remember now—broken items and Saturday morning at the community center. I'll check my garage for that toaster.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, Saturday morning at the community center, I'll bring my broken lamp over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, I'll see you there with my toaster—if I can remember where I put it!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Okay, Bo, let's see what you picked up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Sorry, I got lost in thought. What did you pick up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah, focus! I asked if you have the supplies for the repair drive. Let's check the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus, what time works for you on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'm free after 2 PM on Saturday. How does that sound?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 3 PM works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? We could use your help fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'll be there! What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 9 AM at the community center. Can't wait to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hmm, I'm still not convinced. Can you show me the actual list of supplies before I trust this repair drive idea?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can grab the list. Vik was organizing it, so I'll ask them for a copy.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I'll wait for that list. But I need to see it before I'm on board.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, it's a great way to reduce waste and help neighbors out. You can bring anything from toasters to bicycles, and folks with skills will fix them up for free.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, but do we have a set date and time yet? I'd like to mark my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, it's this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that's right! Saturday morning, I think they're starting around 9.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you happen to have that list of items and locations? I'd like to map out a route.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I grabbed a flyer from the grocery store—I can show you the list I have!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I'm not sure I'm up for it, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it's just this weekend, I think? Might be fun to help out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I've got a lot on my plate right now. Maybe another time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We're looking for items like toasters, radios, laptops, anything electronic that's broken but fixable. Drop-off is at my place, 123 Maple Street, after 3:15 PM on weekdays.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, I'll see if I have anything electronic that needs fixing. Thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, just bring it by anytime after 3:15. I'll be here!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Vik! We're all set for a great turnout. Are you planning to come by?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I'll be there! I'm thinking of bringing my old blender to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Quinn, can you take a look at my brake pads? They're worn thin.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, Mina! I can check them out. By the way, we're planning a repair drive this Friday evening—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Friday evening works for me. What time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have enough supplies organized for the repair drive? I'm a bit worried about the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, don't worry Pia, we'll figure it out. I'm sure folks will bring whatever they have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But Dane, we need a concrete plan. Do we have a meeting point and time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's this Saturday at the community center. I was planning to help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday at the community center? What time exactly? We need to make sure everyone knows when and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's from 10 to 4, I think. That's what Tess told me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, let's see what we've got and get to work!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Gus. I'm still not sure what we're working with. Mind showing me that list of supplies?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Kira! I've got the list right here. Let me grab it for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, like I said, it's a repair drive! People bring in broken appliances, clothes, electronics—anything really—and volunteers with skills fix them up. Totally free, just trying to reduce waste and help neighbors out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh great, I was planning to bring my old blender! What about you?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm not sure yet, maybe I'll just come by and see if anyone needs an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Vik, I heard you mentioned something about the repair drive? Could you tell me more about what items you're collecting and where to drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it's this Saturday at the community center! I heard Jules is bringing a blender. You can bring any small appliances or electronics to fix.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks Vik! So just drop off items at the community center on Saturday? I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let me know when you can do it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think people are meeting up at 9 AM on Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you'll be there? I can bring my brake pads.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what's going on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, it's a community repair drive — we're fixing broken items folks brought in. I just got here myself, but Gus has his toolbox ready and we're about to start checking things out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, right, appliances and stuff. So it's not just bikes or lawnmowers then? I'm still trying to get the full picture here.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We're looking for things like old laptops, phones, toasters, lamps—anything that's broken but fixable. You can drop them off at my garage starting next Monday after 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'll start spreading the word and can help organize a pickup route if anyone needs it!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Quinn! Just keep in mind school pickup times—I'm free after 3:15 most days, so that could work for a route.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Uli! We're getting ready for the repair drive this Saturday. Do you have any broken items to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I might have a small radio, but I'm not sure yet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, just bring it if you can—we'll have tools and people to help fix it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, have we set a date for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, Eli. We should probably get that sorted soon. Mina mentioned her brake pads are worn, so we might want to start with that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's set a date right now then. How about this Saturday at 9 AM sharp?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll bring my old toaster by this weekend. Where's the drop-off point?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: My garage is fine, just leave it by the side door.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, I'll do that. Thanks, Leo!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Here you go, Opal! I've got the list right here with all the items, owners, and addresses. Would you like me to print it out or send it to your phone?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you send it to my phone? That way I can use the addresses to map out the best route.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure, just give me your number and I'll text it to you right away!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Lawnmowers? I thought it was bikes and toasters. Maybe we should check the flyer again; I can never keep these things straight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I just grabbed what was on the list, but I didn't read it carefully.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think I have the flyer somewhere in my stack of papers—let me find it so we can sort this out.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
